shots.image: HERO standing alone on top of a huge mountain of rubbish and black bin bags at a vast landfill at golden hour, both hands on his head in despair, hundreds of seagulls circling, yellow bulldozers far away, dramatic sky.
shots.motion: The camera slowly circles around him as seagulls swirl overhead, he lowers his hands and stares down at the rubbish.

shots.image: Extreme close-up, a small silver laptop hard drive tumbling through the air and falling into an open black bin bag full of rubbish, scraps of paper flying, soft window light, shallow depth of field.
shots.motion: The hard drive tumbles in slow motion and drops into the bag, scraps of rubbish fly up.

shots.image: Night in a small town in South Wales, a wet street of old brick terraced houses with warm glowing windows, light rain, street lamps reflecting on the road, dark green hills behind.
shots.motion: Rain falls, the camera slowly pushes in down the street, a window light flickers.

shots.image: HEROFACE, aged 24, wearing a plain grey T-shirt, sitting at a cluttered desk in a small bedroom at night, typing on an old black laptop whose screen shows only a soft blue glow, the screen light on his face, a mug of tea, cables and computer parts around him.
shots.motion: He types fast, the screen flickers and lights his face, steam rises from the mug.

shots.image: Close-up of an old black laptop on a cluttered desk at night, its screen glowing bright gold, a stream of shiny plain gold coins pouring out of the screen and piling up on the desk, warm magical light, dark bedroom.
shots.motion: Gold coins keep pouring out of the glowing laptop screen and pile up on the desk, the glow pulses.

shots.image: Close-up of a man's hand placing a small silver laptop hard drive into an open wooden desk drawer full of tangled cables and old gadgets, warm lamp light.
shots.motion: The hand sets the hard drive down in the drawer and slowly slides the drawer shut.

shots.image: HERO in a messy spare room on a grey morning, stuffing old cables, computer parts and gadgets into a black bin bag, cardboard boxes and clutter everywhere.
shots.motion: He shoves cables and gadgets into the bin bag and ties it shut, dust floats in the light.

shots.image: Early grey morning in a Welsh town, a row of tied black bin bags on the wet pavement in front of a brick terraced house, one bag torn open showing a small silver hard drive among the rubbish.
shots.motion: Wind ruffles the bin bags, rain drips, a car passes in the background.

shots.image: A huge landfill site under a grey sky, a white rubbish truck with no markings tipping a load of black bin bags onto a mountain of rubbish, hundreds of seagulls swooping, yellow bulldozers spreading the rubbish.
shots.motion: The truck tips the bags onto the landfill, seagulls swoop down, dust rises.

shots.image: HERO in a small kitchen at night, staring at the glowing screen of his phone in shock, mouth wide open, eyes wide, the phone light on his face.
shots.motion: His eyes widen and his mouth falls open as he stares at the phone, slow push-in on his face.

shots.image: HERO kneeling by a wooden desk, yanking out an empty drawer in a panic, cables and gadgets scattered all over the floor, desk lamp light.
shots.motion: He yanks the drawer out and rummages through it frantically, gadgets fall to the floor.

shots.image: HEROFACE wearing a plain navy jacket, sitting at a desk in a grey government office, leaning forward and pleading with two stern middle-aged officials in dark suits across the desk, who look back unmoved, papers on the desk.
shots.motion: He leans forward pleading with open hands, the officials slowly shake their heads.

shots.image: HERO gripping a tall chain-link fence with both hands, seen from the side, staring through it at a vast landfill of rubbish under a grey rainy sky, seagulls circling.
shots.motion: He grips the fence and stares through it, rain falls, seagulls circle over the landfill.

shots.image: HEROFACE wearing a plain dark suit, standing in a modern glass boardroom presenting a detailed scale model of a landfill on the table to four investors in suits, a large wall screen behind him showing a glowing blue 3D scan of layers of earth.
shots.motion: He gestures at the model, the investors lean in, the 3D scan slowly rotates on the screen.

shots.image: Two unbranded yellow four-legged robot dogs and a small white drone on a huge landfill at dusk, scanning the rubbish with beams of blue light, seagulls, dramatic sky, mountains of black bin bags.
shots.motion: The robot dogs walk across the rubbish scanning with blue light, the drone hovers, dust drifts.

shots.image: Inside a wood-panelled British courtroom, a stern grey-haired judge in a black robe at a high wooden bench, and HEROFACE in a plain dark suit standing below beside his lawyer, looking up anxiously, soft window light.
shots.motion: The judge looks down and shakes his head, James lowers his eyes, slow push-in.

shots.image: HEROFACE in a plain dark suit and raincoat walking slowly down the wide stone steps of a grand old court building in the rain, head down, holding a folder of papers, grey city street.
shots.motion: He walks slowly down the steps in the rain with his head down, rain falls.

shots.image: A huge landfill being closed, yellow bulldozers pushing brown soil over the last of the rubbish, a wide smooth hill of fresh earth, grey sky, seagulls, a fence in the foreground.
shots.motion: The bulldozers push soil over the rubbish, dust drifts, the camera slowly rises.

shots.image: HEROFACE, now around forty with a short brown beard, wearing a plain dark jacket, sitting alone on a grassy hill at sunset, seen from the side, looking down at a distant landfill with the sea beyond, golden light.
shots.motion: Wind moves the grass, the sun sinks slowly, he sits still, staring at the landfill.

shots.image: Cross-section view cut through the ground of a landfill, many thick layers of compressed rubbish, black bin bags and brown soil, grass on top, and deep down in the middle a tiny silver hard drive glinting in a thin beam of light.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pushes down through the layers toward the hard drive, which glints faintly.

shots.image: Close-up of HEROFACE, now around forty with a short brown beard, wearing a plain dark jacket, standing outdoors at dusk with a landfill blurred behind him, looking straight at the camera with a faint sad smile.
shots.motion: He looks at the camera with a faint sad smile, wind moves his hair, slow push-in.

shots.image: Close-up at a landfill, a small dirty silver laptop hard drive half-buried among crumpled rubbish, torn black bin bags and dirt, a single beam of golden light catching it, shallow depth of field.
shots.motion: A faint glint slides across the hard drive, scraps of rubbish shift in the wind, slow push-in.

shots.image: HEROFACE in a plain dark suit standing in front of a huge landfill on a bright day, holding a thick folder of documents out toward the camera with a hopeful smile, yellow bulldozers and seagulls behind him.
shots.motion: He holds the folder out hopefully, wind moves his hair, seagulls circle behind him, slow push-in.
